description: This file contains unit tests for the SecurePrefs class, specifically testing notification forwarding quiet hours configuration and retrieval of notification forwarding policies within an Android application.

classes.name: SecurePrefsNotificationForwardingTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing notification quiet hours management and notification forwarding policies within the SecurePrefs class.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_rejectsInvalidDraftsWithoutMutatingStoredValues
methods.description: Tests that setting invalid notification quiet hours does not mutate the stored preferences.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_persistsValidDraftsAndEnabledState
methods.description: Verifies that valid quiet hours settings are persisted correctly and the enabled state is updated.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_disablesWithoutRevalidatingDrafts
methods.description: Checks that disabling notification quiet hours does not revalidate or mutate the previous values.

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy_readsLatestQuietHoursImmediately
methods.description: Ensures that the notification forwarding policy reflects the latest quiet hours settings immediately after they are set.

methods.name: notificationForwarding_defaultsDisabledForSaferPosture
methods.description: Verifies default notification forwarding and policy mode are disabled or set to safe defaults.
